brand.notes: Every wordmark goes through the \ac macro. The pink period is visible in the cover subtitle, the byline, the section 7 heading, body prose, and bibliography entries at full resolution.

diagrams.notes: Two rows of three equal tiers, uniform height, gutters and inner padding; every third line clears its box border. The dashed free/nonfree line spans the full width with its two labels stacked at the left end, clear of all boxes. Sans labels read at normal page size; the free/nonfree split is carried by color and by the rotated side labels, not color alone. No edges to route: enclosure is stated inside each free tier, and copyleft's bold 'cannot be enclosed' is the only emphasis, which is the intended hierarchy.
